sections.title: A plan in short sentences
sections.content: A plan is a few short sentences. Say what is on, invite, and ask what suits: *Szombaton buli van. Szeretnél jönni?* Then ask the time and the place: *Hánykor találkozunk? Hol találkozunk?* New words: *akkor* (then), *találkozó* (meeting, appointment) and *megbeszél* (to arrange, to talk over).

sections.title: A plan, step by step
rows: There is a party on Saturday.
When is it good for you?
At what time do we meet?

items.english: There is a party on Saturday. Would you like to come?
On Sunday I want to walk in the park.
We meet in front of the café.

sections.content: Day first, then time or place: *Szombaton fél nyolckor a kávézó előtt.*
